name: Cordyceps: deep orange under pink light
summary: Swaps white light for a red and blue pink mix during stroma growth, the light that gave the heaviest, most colorful fruit bodies in the cited trial.
notes: The pink mix starts after the orange initials form. Expect the stroma stage to take about five weeks.
chamber_notes: This profile only sets climate. Media is on you. Chamber limits: there is no heater or cooler, so temperature targets only hold if the room sits near them. There is no CO2 sensor, so the fan schedule stands in for fresh air. The humidifier can only add moisture, so a low humidity target depends on dry room air.

source_notes.title: Dong et al. 2013, Cordyceps militaris light quality
source_notes.detail: Dong J. Z. et al., Journal of Food Biochemistry 37 (2013). Pink light, one third at 450 to 460 nm and two thirds at 620 to 630 nm, gave the highest dry matter (40.06%) and bioefficiency and raised carotenoid and cordycepin content. Daylight was not suitable.

stages.name: Colonization
stages.notes: Dark. Do not start light until the surface is colonized.

stages.name: Orange initials
stages.notes: Bright, cooler light helps stroma form.

stages.name: Stroma, pink light
stages.notes: Red and blue only. White stays off.

light_recipe.why: Initials keep the free card light. Stroma growth uses red at twice the blue drive level to approximate the two thirds red, one third blue pink light in Dong 2013. White is off because daylight did poorly in that trial.
light_recipe.wavelength_note: WS2812 red is roughly 620 to 630 nm and blue roughly 465 to 475 nm. The RGB mix is an approximation of the cited wavelengths, not a measured spectrum. RGB percent is LED drive level, not a photon ratio.

sources.title: Wu 2016 Cordyceps militaris
sources.detail: Chiu-Yeh Wu et al., Effects of Illumination Pattern during Cultivation of Fruiting Body and Bioactive Compound Production by Cordyceps militaris, Int. J. Med. Mushrooms 18 (2016). Colonization in a spawn room without a stated photoperiod. Primordia and fruiting at 12 h per day. Highest dry yield at 1750 plus or minus 250 lux. Highest cordycepin at 1250 plus or minus 250 lux. This recipe maps 51% white to about 1250 lux.

sources.title: Lin et al. 2024 Cordyceps LED
sources.detail: Yu-Wen Lin et al., Growth of Cordyceps militaris cultivation and its bioactive component accumulation as affected by various single-wavelength LED light sources, International Journal of Food Properties 27 (2024). Single-wavelength LEDs changed bioactive compound levels. This paper is used only for a blue bias, not for a yield or lux number.
